description: This file 'util.cc' contains implementation of utility functions for command handling and inter-process communication for the Cuttlefish Android emulator project. It includes functions for reading and writing binary messages over file descriptors, managing launcher actions, and interfacing with monitor sockets.

classes.name: LauncherActionInfo
classes.description: Structure representing launcher action and its extended information.

classes.name: LauncherResponse
classes.description: Enumeration for responses from launcher actions.

methods.name: bool IsShortAction(const LauncherAction action)
methods.description: Determine if a given launcher action is considered 'short' in duration.

methods.name: Result<void> WriteAllBinaryResult(const SharedFD & fd,const T * t)
methods.description: Write a binary protobuf message to a shared file descriptor, ensuring all data is written.

methods.name: Result<bool> ReadExactBinaryResult(const SharedFD & fd,T * t)
methods.description: Read exactly the size of a protobuf message from a shared file descriptor.

methods.name: Result<RunnerExitCodes> ReadExitCode(SharedFD monitor_socket)
methods.description: Read the exit code of a runner process from a socket.

methods.name: Result<SharedFD> GetLauncherMonitorFromInstance(const CuttlefishConfig::InstanceSpecific & instance_config,const int timeout_seconds)
methods.description: Create and connect to a launcher monitor socket for a specific instance configuration.

methods.name: Result<SharedFD> GetLauncherMonitor(const CuttlefishConfig & config,const int instance_num,const int timeout_seconds)
methods.description: Get launcher monitor socket for a given configuration and instance number.

methods.name: Result<std::optional<LauncherActionInfo>> ReadLauncherActionFromFd(SharedFD monitor_socket)
methods.description: Read a launcher action from a file descriptor, including optional extended actions.

methods.name: Result<void> WaitForRead(SharedFD monitor_socket,const int timeout_seconds)
methods.description: Wait for readability on a socket with a timeout using select.

methods.name: Result<void> RunLauncherAction(SharedFD monitor_socket,const run_cvd::ExtendedLauncherAction & extended_action,std::optional<int> timeout_seconds)
methods.description: Send a launcher action command via socket and wait for success response.

methods.name: Result<void> RunLauncherAction(SharedFD monitor_socket,LauncherAction action,std::optional<int> timeout_seconds)
methods.description: Send an extended launcher action command via socket and wait for success response.
